title: 客户等级销售额
query: 只查询 askdata_mock：查询2026年8月各客户等级的销售额，按实付金额汇总，从高到低排序，不额外筛选订单状态。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: SELECT customers.customer_level AS "客户等级", SUM(orders_current.paid_amount) AS "销售额" FROM orders_current JOIN customers ON orders_current.customer_id = customers.customer_id WHERE orders_current.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY customers.customer_level ORDER BY "销售额" DESC LIMIT 200
